name: Power Bank (Lithium Battery)
aliases: can you bring portable chargers on planes
are battery packs allowed on carry on
description: Guidelines for traveling with power bank (lithium battery) in your luggage.

carryOn.reason: Lithium-ion power banks are strictly prohibited in checked baggage because of the risk of thermal runaway and fire in the cargo hold. They must be carried in the cabin.
conditions: Limited to a capacity of 100 watt-hours (Wh) per battery without airline approval.
Terminal connections must be protected from short circuits (e.g. by keeping in retail packaging or tape over terminals).

tsa.pageTitle: Can I bring power bank (lithium battery) on a plane?

airlines.name: Air France
airlines.notes: Max 100Wh allowed in carry-on without approval (max 2 spare units between 100Wh-160Wh with airline permission). Prohibited in checked hold.

airlines.name: Delta Air Lines
airlines.notes: Lithium power banks permitted in carry-on only (under 100Wh). Prohibited in checked luggage.

airlines.name: United Airlines
airlines.notes: Power banks allowed in cabin bags only. Checked hold carriage strictly prohibited.

airlines.name: Lufthansa
airlines.notes: Max 2 portable power banks (up to 100Wh each) in carry-on. Prohibited in checked hold.

airlines.name: Emirates
airlines.notes: Lithium power banks must be carried in cabin baggage (under 100Wh). Checked luggage prohibited.

airlines.name: Singapore Airlines
airlines.notes: Must be in carry-on baggage. Max 100Wh standard; 100Wh-160Wh requires airline approval.

travelTips: Limited to a capacity of 100 watt-hours (Wh) per battery without airline approval.

faq.question: Is power bank (lithium battery) allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: Power Bank (Lithium Battery) is allowed in carry-on luggage. Lithium-ion power banks are strictly prohibited in checked baggage because of the risk of thermal runaway and fire in the cargo hold. They must be carried in the cabin.

faq.question: Can you pack power bank (lithium battery) in checked baggage?
faq.answer: Yes, Power Bank (Lithium Battery) is not allowed in checked bags.

faq.question: What are the power bank rules for Air France, Delta, and United?
faq.answer: Power banks and portable chargers must ALWAYS be packed in carry-on baggage and are strictly prohibited in checked luggage. Standard limit is 100Wh (approx. 27,000mAh) per power bank.
